reference.comparison_rule: Record actual hardware and build; keep development observations separate from optimized delivery gates.

hosting_queue_selection.quota_semantics: Reserve within shared device/host budgets before dispatch; reconnect and source changes preserve already spent download counters.
hosting_queue_selection.limit_status: Fixture parameters for implementation and controlled overload cases; no current transport certification.
hosting_queue_selection.limit_scope: Small Stage 02/05 reference host with one editor and one public visitor. Increasing participants is a separately measured admitted profile, not automatic capacity.

preflight_benchmark.result: Estimate with actual method/device; never a safety or future-performance certificate.

hosting_queue_selection.rate_semantics: Admission limits, separate from simulated link bandwidth/loss. Account aggregate host work and persistent transferred bytes; replacement presence is coalesced.

measurement_rules: Record local processing latency, network RTT and asset waiting separately.
Measure peak old/new fallback, decode, upload, in-flight and replacement allocations across every active view.
Report total process RSS separately from incremental model CPU bytes and managed GPU estimates.
A lower visual profile preserves accepted dimensions, rights, collider/runtime authority and semantic coverage labels.
Source positional accuracy, numerical preservation and projected visual error are separate quantities.
Qualitative review covers horizon/interior continuity, readable mounted input, useful low-poly shape and clear partial/repair states.
A failed target records the responsible queue/product/algorithm and actual result; changes to governing budgets require the existing scope review.

character_phase_selection.source: starter-character.glb; original full source remains retained separately
character_phase_selection.counts_evidence: dataset-inspection.json records actual source/rig/clip/texture counts; these caps do not measure runtime deformation or residency.

pose_tests.check: Compare retained source positions, skin weights/joint indices and admitted animation samples exactly; validate finite normalized weights and source transforms.
Use declared eye/foot/forward/up anchors, authored idle/walk transition and support-ready doorway traversal; body/camera remain separately owned.
Selected-copy material/rigid bandana appearance and whole-occurrence scale only for this supplied variant; arbitrary rebind/proportions remain explicit unsupported until stage 11.

Select actual FK/IK residual, binding/deformation error, pose extremes, motion/retarget and protected attachment cases before implementation; compare the differently articulated mechanism through the same commands.

character_phase_selection.custom_variant: character-variant.json; original source and unselected copies retained
character_phase_selection.mechanism: mechanism.glb; two links and explicit differently structured ports, no physical joint law

anatomical_coverage.coverage_rights_counts_and_pose_mapping: Required before stage 11 implementation; optional male/female reference packs, not a startup dependency.

character_phase_selection.new_force_driven_or_cloth_hair_tissue_be: Deferred to stages 18–21; existing authored animations do not certify a physical law.

future_core_quality_targets.simplification_guarantee: Report attained error and sampled versus bounded coverage; protected passage/mount validity and qualitative silhouette remain required.
future_core_quality_targets.structural_microscopic_round_trip: Relative to declared input precision; choose actual bounded SDF/CIF/PDBx fixture and tolerance at stage 12.
future_core_quality_targets.source_registration: Within declared source/transform uncertainty with withheld checks; no universal geographic centimetre claim.
future_core_quality_targets.status: Selected initial core targets; achieved runtime results remain pending at phase owners.
